# Myth

Myth carries inherited **whole stories and scenes** whose actions disclose a live relation. The current field includes the whole Ares–Aphrodite–Harmonia / Hephaestus–Poseidon relation; Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus; the project-composed Apollo–Dionysus–Daphne comparison; Job together with the later Jungian interpretation layered over it; the ouroboros / torus / trickster whole; the Attica contest; the *Hypostasis of the Archons* cosmology; and other mythic fields admitted by exact recovery.

The story is primary. A record follows enough of its beginning, actors, setting, actions, reversals, transformations, verdicts and aftermath that the operation is visible **between** the figures rather than assigned to them as fixed attributes. Variant tellings remain distinct wholes until an authored comparison joins them.

Only after that recovery may a character or symbolic component become separately addressable. Athena, Poseidon, Apollo, Daphne, serpent, tree, water, net, olive, laurel, whirlwind, Leviathan, Norea, Sophia, veil, ruler/archon and similar figures can then be indexed across stories. Such an index must say what the figure does in each whole, where its office changes, what relation recurs through the change, and how to return to the intact telling.

Higher-order archetypal fields are built the same way. “Serpent” is not assigned a dictionary meaning and then used to decode Cecrops, Python, ouroboros or another image. Cecrops-as-earth-born serpent-human, Python within Apollo's story, and the ouroboros in its own whole are first recovered locally; only then may their differences and recurrences disclose a larger serpent field.

Every **project interpretation** attached to those wholes or later indexes carries `human-amplified: yes/no`. `yes` means Frank has supplied or ratified the symbolic/Jungian appointment. `no` means the system has produced a candidate amplification which must remain available for human encounter rather than being propagated as though it already carried authorial standing.

## Worked whole-record exemplars

[[symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/attica-athena-poseidon-cecrops/WHOLE|Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim]] is the first record to instantiate the full form, including relation-local human-amplification state.

[[symbolon/mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/hypostasis-archons-norea-sophia/WHOLE|The Hypostasis of the Archons — Sophia, Veil, Rulers, Adam, Norea, Eleleth, and the Root Above]] is the first source-first cosmological whole admitted specifically to resolve Native 020's layered-cosmos / firmament / archons seam. It preserves the veil-divided cosmology, derivative rulers, human drama, Norea's refusal and Eleleth's revelation before any modern QL, political or technical amplification is allowed to propagate.

The operational form is:

```text
source whole / variants / historical continuation
        ↓
complete relational scene
        ↓
human-amplified yes/no ledger
        ↓
human-ratified Jungian / Symbolonic reading
        ↓
system amplification queue
        ↓
cross-register routes
        ↓
derived character / animal / plant / element indexes
        ↓
later cross-whole archetypal constellation
        ↺
return to intact story
```

Attica's current human-amplified core includes Poseidon's sea/well as the archaic-magical/unconscious depth retained at the centre of Athena/Minerva's rational-civic form, the toroidal reading of that relation, and the olive's root→fruit→pressing→oil→anointing→flame/light chain. System-generated readings of Cecrops, the flood and other elements are retained separately as `human-amplified: no` until Frank works them.

The *Hypostasis* record is deliberately more conservative: the source whole is recovered, while its proposed Hybris/frame/technical-governance comparisons remain `human-amplified: no` pending Frank's encounter.

This story-first law lets amplification expand the Mytheme world without atomising it. See [Mytheme Whole-Story Amplification Law] and [Native 020].

Myth figures liveability, enclosure, transformation, conflict, inheritance, return or failure; it does not prove a Matheme. Episteme carries source variants and scholarly history; Matheme carries exact formal relations; the Myth page preserves the image-world from which either later abstraction may take one operation.
